title: The Future of Research in the Age of AI
author: Pierre Marion

metaphors.title: A narrow ridge
metaphors.paraphrase: Between a bright AI-assisted future and churning out pointless papers ever faster lies a narrow ridge.

metaphors.title: Airline pilots
metaphors.paraphrase: Learn from professions like airline pilots that faced automation-driven skill erosion; LLMs as a superpower PhD students must learn to pilot.

metaphors.title: Collapse of the h-index
metaphors.paraphrase: Producing papers becomes a commodity, so their value for hiring and evaluation collapses.
